entities.name: DCN-ID
entities.description: Information element that provides a DCN-ID (Dedicated Core Network Identifier) to the UE when included in a message by the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the DCN-ID IE in a message to provide a DCN-ID to the UE.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives the DCN-ID information element from the network.

relations.description: Network includes the DCN-ID IE in a message when it wishes to provide a DCN-ID to the UE.
The DCN-ID IE provides a DCN-ID to the UE when included in a message by the network.
